# Decisions (Acme Notes API S21)

- D-t02: Build against API version v1 with base path AX-63003 (error format AX-40567). Relies on facts: product.api_version = v1, api.base_path = AX-63003, api.error_format = AX-40567. Recorded facts were re-checked against repo/api.py and agree.
- D-t02 (update, adopt v2): Adopt API version v2 for task t02-choose-api-version. Relies on fact: product.api_version = v2 (source: acme-docs/06_api_style_guide_v2.md). It governs over the earlier D-t02 entry built on product.api_version = v1, because the fact records v1 as superseded and its guide (acme-docs/02_api_style_guide_v1.md) as withdrawn.
- D-t13: Reuse the S07 billing cycle ("quarterly, invoiced on day 7", found in history/MEMORY.md and history/logs/researcher.jsonl, Bolt Billing API S07) and the S13 API-key header ("API key in X-Core-Key header", found in history/MEMORY.md and history/logs/planner.jsonl, Acme Notes API S13). Code settings recorded alongside from repo/billing.py: billing.cycle = AX-56904, billing.currency = AX-11674. history/ has no billing currency, so none is reused. Note the S13 header is only a reuse reference: this sprint's t05 decision (JWT for user traffic, X-Api-Key deferred) still governs auth.
- D-t05: Use JWT bearer tokens (RS256, Acme identity provider) for all user traffic. Globex's long-lived `X-Api-Key` request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred as a separate, scoped service-credential option for back-office scripts, to be reviewed by the security team (no code change now). Relies on facts: security.auth_method = JWT bearer tokens, signed with RS256, issued by the Acme identity provider; customer.requested_auth_method = long-lived API key in X-Api-Key header. The security note governs because it is the security team's standard and long-lived keys weaken it. Also re-read repo/auth.py: auth.token_ttl = AX-65554 (code differs from the earlier recorded AX-81591; code governs), auth.key_header = AX-59960.
- D-t09: REJECT the CRUD spec (artifacts/t07-implement-crud-spec/crud-spec.md) for revision. It states it is built on API version v1, but the governing fact is product.api_version = v2 (v1 superseded, its guide withdrawn; see D-t02 update), so it must be rebased on v2 (the t12 v2 endpoints, and the v2 test plan from t08). Auth is fine: JWT RS256 bearer matches security.auth_method and D-t05, and its auth.token_ttl = AX-65554 matches current repo/auth.py. Code values re-read and agree with the spec: api.base_path = AX-63003, db.engine = AX-73157. Relies on facts: product.api_version = v2, security.auth_method = JWT bearer tokens RS256, auth.token_ttl = AX-65554, api.base_path = AX-63003, db.engine = AX-73157.
